baselines.B_maj: majority dx sign (= clock-only = proprio-only at step 0)
baselines.B_mean: predict the training-fold mean apple xy
baselines.B_occ: occlusion-conditional mean (privileged; the harder T1 bar)
baselines.B_rand: source iii, measured in the run
baselines.B_y: y-conditional dx-sign prior, 5 train-fold quantile bins of true apple y (privileged)

calibration.scratch_not_committed: MSAA-pattern emulation from a non-MSAA 448 render: best mean abs difference >= 1.75 levels (6 train roots)

cohort.disclosure: TASK-057 D1-pipeline re-rendered 15 of the 20 val roots; they are val-split members, never a gating cohort
cohort.roots: all 190 train+val roots of the frozen collection plan (170 train, 20 val), one reset frame each, aim-offset roots included; branch episodes excluded

descriptive_non_decisional: visibility over time on the 170 train roots along the nominal expert (orient+descend, 210 commands): first step with >=1 and >=10 apple pixels, never-visible share, x offset to orient target at that step vs the 6 mm saturation band, sign(dx) at that step vs step 0, step at which the x offset first enters the band
apple pixels at reset in overview (112, 448) and in the hand_crop_rgb window

guards_void_the_run.G_expert: recomputed step-0 expert equals recorded label within 1e-6 on the 152 non-aim roots; apple label equals reset truth within 1e-6 m
guards_void_the_run.G_hash: every file in `hashes` matches; every episode file matches the dataset manifest sha256 before decoding; encoder weight digests match `sources`
guards_void_the_run.G_render: 112 px re-render byte-identical on 190/190; reset proprio max std <= 1e-6
guards_void_the_run.G_split: exactly the plan's 190 train+val seeds, splits agree with the dataset manifest; refuse test ids, cohort C, cohort D, seeds outside 48000-48199; fold hash matches
guards_void_the_run.not_a_guard: native equivalence (known to fail; why source v is non-decisional)

metrics.T1: median Euclidean error cm (mean reported); 95% percentile bootstrap over roots, 10000 resamples, default_rng(5901); paired bootstrap ratio to a baseline
metrics.T3: MAE with bootstrap CI; paired bootstrap ratio to constant-median-dx MAE
metrics.strata: all; occluded (0 apple pixels at 112 px); visible (>= 1 pixel)

rerenders.apple_hidden: apple geom moved to a hidden geom group: not drawn, casts no shadow

occluded_explanation_check.rule: same out-of-fold fitted readouts applied unchanged; still above prior on apple-hidden => spurious, the source is treated as not succeeding overall; drops to prior => believed, with shadow-off deciding shadow vs residual apple pixels
occluded_explanation_check.trigger: any decisional source beats the prior on the occluded stratum

pre_declared_outcomes_in_order.reading: frame carries the information and E0 exposes it; BC objective/data is the problem

pre_declared_outcomes_in_order.condition: E0 does not succeed on all roots but A3, raw-112 or random does
pre_declared_outcomes_in_order.reading: E0 discards information present in the frame

pre_declared_outcomes_in_order.condition: no decisional source succeeds on all roots; E0 succeeds on the visible stratum
pre_declared_outcomes_in_order.reading: occlusion at reset binds on occluded resets (camera placement / reset pose); BC is the problem on visible resets

pre_declared_outcomes_in_order.condition: no source succeeds on all roots; E0 fails the visible stratum but raw-112, A3 or random succeeds there
pre_declared_outcomes_in_order.reading: occlusion binds and E0 discards the visible apple too

pre_declared_outcomes_in_order.condition: no source succeeds on all roots and none on the visible stratum
pre_declared_outcomes_in_order.reading: camera is the problem; resolution vs placement not separable here; source v reported as unvalidated qualifier

predecessor.outcome: X: the apple_policy_v1 section 7 abandonment clause fired; the next task must be a perception/data task

process.post_freeze_defects: escalated to the task owner; fixed only by disclosed amendment
process.reported_verdicts_only: A gated run starts only on the pre-run reviewer's REPORTED verdict, delivered as a message - never on a review file read from disk. Same rule for merging: only on the reviewer's reported APPROVE.

question: can the apple xy and the expert's step-0 command (above all right_dx sign and size) be read out from the reset frame, and from which feature source?

readouts.F2: RBF kernel, sigma^2 = median squared pairwise distance of training-part rows
readouts.T2_rule: sign of unclipped dx prediction; exact 0 counts as wrong
readouts.form: dual (kernel) ridge on n <= 171 training rows; identical for every source
readouts.preprocessing: float64; centre by training-part mean; no per-dimension scaling
readouts.selection: family and lambda per (source, target group, outer fold) by 5-fold inner CV on the outer training part minimizing MSE; inner folds default_rng(5900 + outer_fold).permutation, position mod 5
readouts.targets_centred: training-part mean is the intercept; T1 fitted jointly (2 outputs)

i_E0.what: image_features of the frozen E0 encoder as arm A2 uses it

ii_A3.what: image_features of arm A3's fine-tuned encoder

iii_random.what: image_features of arm A1's frozen random-init encoder (same architecture, seed)

v_b_raw_448_down.what: source v box-downsampled 4x4 to 112 px; sizes the render-path confound

v_raw_448.what: 448 px native render of the recorded reset, flattened, /255
v_raw_448.why_not_decisional: native-to-112 equivalence cannot be shown (calibration.native_equivalence); task-owner ruling 2026-09-25: reported only, 'resolution is the problem' reading withdrawn

split.fold_rule: roots sorted by seed; np.random.default_rng(59).permutation(190); fold = position mod 10 (19 per fold)
split.primary: grouped 10-fold CV over the 190 roots (one frame per root)
split.why_cv_is_primary: families and capacity fixed a priori with tuning nested in folds; n=20 val cannot carry a decision (19/20 has Wilson lower 0.764)

stated_in_advance: an overall pass needs occluded-reset information, which the frame should not carry (ceiling 0.768 if visible perfect and occluded at majority); expected outcome is an O-OCC row; O-BC / O-ENC are believed only after the occluded explanation check
status: preregistration; no readout has been fitted on any image or encoder feature

targets.T1: apple xy at reset, world frame (privileged__apple_position_world[0][:2])
targets.T2: sign of the recomputed expert's step-0 right_dx (apple_collector_policy)
targets.T3: the recomputed expert's step-0 right_dx value in [-0.4, 0.4]

thresholds.T1_pass: median <= 1.5 cm AND upper 95% paired-bootstrap bound of median(source)/median(B_occ) <= 0.6
thresholds.T2_pass: accuracy >= 0.85 AND Wilson 95% lower > B_maj on the same roots
thresholds.beats_prior_on_stratum: Wilson lower of T2 > max(B_maj, B_y) on the stratum, OR upper bound of T1 ratio to B_occ < 1.0

justification.T1: 1.5 cm grasp tolerance (apple_policy_v1 2.2); B_mean 2.369 and B_occ 1.939 cm both fail it; ratio <= 0.6 makes the effective bar about 1.16 cm overall, 1.03 cm visible
justification.T2: B_maj 0.616; 0.85 removes >= 60% of prior errors; 162/190 has Wilson lower 0.795, 68/79 has 0.768
justification.T3: B_const MAE 0.314; a sign-perfect +-0.4 readout scores 0.040 (0.13x)

thresholds.random_floor_qualifier: E0/A3 beats the floor if the paired-bootstrap 95% CI of median T1 error (source - random) lies below 0 AND its T2 accuracy exceeds random's; else 'not attributable to pretraining'
thresholds.succeeds: T1 and T2 and T3 pass on the set of roots

what_this_task_is: a single-frame information-ceiling probe on the reset frame; trains no controller, opens no cohort, preregisters no control formulation
